gates.binaryDisablement: explicit option, native propagation, pre-conversion wire evidence per leg

classes.clean-score: No new hot-path flow/wire counters, perf, pprof, or trace.
classes.perf: Uninstrumented source, per-PID Linux perf 49 Hz with calibrated call chains.
classes.ffi-flow: Go v2 only; per-second Go and native lifecycle ledgers, actual queue high-water, exact phase-boundary and count reconciliation.
classes.rust-flow: Standalone Rust SDK/direct-driver completion rates by Unix second; separate from clean scores.
classes.scheduler: Bounded PID-attached perf sched plus per-thread status/schedstat; not a system-wide scheduler capture.
classes.go-diagnostic: Go CPU/heap pprof and bounded runtime trace, separate from perf and flow rates.
classes.wire-proof: Short binary-disablement validation, never authoritative performance scores.
